mentions.story: Neil Gaiman: Why defend freedom of icky speech?
mentions.why: Zappa on censorship, supporting the commenter's free speech argument.
mentions.quote: I don't have a platitude for why we need to defend speech. My only argument has ever been that my icky speech today is your essential speech tomorrow. By the time you think something needs to be censored is beyond the line of where you could still rationally discuss the idea.…
